text:
Pranav: heads-up — noticed a regression after publishing node-sdk@2.4.0. Our exports map changed and a few of the edge sample apps (cloudflare/bun) are failing with ESM/CJS import errors. repro in sample-apps/websocket-proxy.
Sasha: ugh. saw a couple of issues in CI too. error is `Uncaught SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module` from the worker runtime. stack points at our `./dist/cjs/index.js` being selected by some consumers, but edge runtimes try to grab `./dist/esm/index.js` and then TypeScript types don't line up.
Pranav: here's the exports block we shipped (package.json):
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Mike: the conditional export looks fine at a glance, but edge runtimes (and Bun) have inconsistent resolution for the `default`/`import` fallbacks. Also noticed `types` pointing to a different shape than the esm build — that breaks auto-imports in editors.
Alisa: any quick patch we can publish? customers hitting the edge sample flow during onboarding is bad. :grimacing:
Sasha: temporary workarounds that helped my local repro:
- force node consumers to use CJS: `import sdk = require('@redwood-inference/node-sdk');`
- or explicit dynamic import for ESM path: `const sdk = await import('@redwood-inference/node-sdk/dist/esm/index.js')`
but both suck for DX.
Pranav: devex-bot posted the failing CI job earlier:
devex-bot: [CI] sample-apps/websocket-proxy — integration → FAILED on Node 18 (edge emulation)
Mike: short term I can publish 2.4.1 that removes `default` fallback and points `import`/`require` to the same file, and make `types` mirror `dist/esm` types. That should make resolution deterministic for edge runtimes.
Alisa: +1. also add a test in sample-apps that runs the worker under an edge-like runtime (miniflare/bun) on publish pipeline so we catch this earlier.
Sasha: note for long term: we should stop shipping separate cjs/esm directories and instead ship single ESM-first entry with a small cjs shim (or use conditional package aliasing). That reduces mismatch between builds.
Pranav: agreed. action items:
- Mike to publish 2.4.1 with simplified exports map and aligned types (target: today)
- Sasha to add a minimal edge-resolve test in sample-apps CI (PR incoming)
- Alisa to notify support/onboarding docs if we expect a brief rollback window

Pranav: I'll open the patch PR and tag releases + attach regression notes. If you have a small repro snippet for the Bun failure post it here so I can include it in the PR description.

Sasha: posting bun repro quick snippet:
```bash
# repro with bun
git clone git@github.com:redwood/sample-apps.git
cd sample-apps/websocket-proxy
bun install
bun run start --target edge
# observe SyntaxError in console
```
Mike: publishing 2.4.1 now (will bump thread when done). :rocket:
